preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 4 inclusive.
K is an integer between 2 and 9 inclusive.
The product of K raised to the power of N is greater than 1 and less than 4096.

postconditions.description: The length of the string S is at least the number of possible strings of size N.

postconditions.expression: all(substring in S for substring in [str(i) for i in range(K^N)])
postconditions.description: The string S contains all possible strings of size N.
The length of the string S is the minimum possible length that satisfies the previous conditions.
